title: Mystery of Costa Rican Spheres

scenes.text: Why do 300 stone balls line a rainforest road?
They were discovered scattered across the Diquís region of Guanacaste, Costa Rica.
Scientists dated the spheres to between 1,000 and 1,500 years old.
Early 20th‑century photos show locals moving the spheres on wooden rollers.
scenes.archive_query: Costa Rica Diquís stone spheres early photographs

scenes.text: No consensus on their purpose – ritual, marker, or ancient art?
scenes.label: UNSOLVED PURPOSE
scenes.sub: Scholars still debate why they were placed.

description: Thousands of perfect stone spheres lie hidden in a Costa Rican rainforest, their age known but their purpose a mystery. Dive into the clues scientists have uncovered.
